Privacy Policy

1. Hosting & Logfiles

This site is hosted on a private server. Standard server logs (requested URL, timestamp, IP address, user agent) are collected for operational security and are automatically deleted after 7 days.

2. No Cookies & No Tracking

This website does not use cookies, tracking pixels, analytics services, fingerprinting, or any form of third-party data collection. We have no interest in who you are or what you do on this site.

3. Local Storage Only

The editor uses your browser's localStorage exclusively to save your preferences (theme, text, configuration). No data from localStorage is transmitted to any server – it never leaves your device.

4. Fully Client-Side

KoalaSnap runs entirely in your browser. All rendering, image processing, and PNG export happen client-side. There is no backend, no database, and no user account. No data is uploaded, stored, or processed on any server.

5. Open Source

KoalaSnap is 100% open source. Every line of code can be publicly viewed and audited on GitHub.

6. Your Rights

You have the right to information, correction, or deletion of your data. Since the editor stores all data exclusively in your browser's localStorage, you can clear it at any time via your browser settings or by simply using the "Reset" function in the editor.

Contact: koalasnap@koalastuff.net
